name: Necromancer bench: Command: Gargoyle lets a commanded kill give experience with no swing
contract: SoloKill.RequirePlayerHit (#10365) gives an ungrouped player experience from a creature only if the player registered a hit on it. Order() (AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp:405) drives the minion but may not register that hit. Raise: Gargoyle 500329 (3 Life Force) summons creature 50067; its capacity needs Scourge Apprentice Training 680283 (base 2 -> 3). Command: Gargoyle 504052 is plain trainer-learnable (SkillLineAbility 23149, no talent gate). The Necromancer raises one Gargoyle, orders Command: Gargoyle at a creature, never swings, and the Gargoyle alone kills it. This bench checks whether the necromancer still gains experience from that kill.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: Life Force capacity is raised to 3
Let the Gargoyle take its formation place and the global cooldown pass
Select the creature so Order() finds it through GetTarget() (504052's own effect targets the caster)
SETUP: the Command cast went through
SETUP: the Gargoyle kills the creature
BENCH: the commanded kill gives experience
BENCH: the experience did not cross a level
